summary: Frontend-only mobile-web (390x844) verification of AzoApp Partner iteration 67 — live SSE dispatch + full-screen JobRingOverlay. All 4 requested feature areas PASS. Login via 'Maybe later' → 'Partner Demo' works; azo_token persisted in localStorage (165 chars). After login the Realtime provider opened GET /api/realtime/stream?token=… (status 200, connection stayed open) and Job Request tab footer shows 'Live dispatch connected · Updated HH:MM' when the jobs list is empty. Dashboard → 'Alert check' card → tap [data-testid=test-job-ring] → within ~3s [data-testid=job-ring-overlay] appears full-screen with all required strings: 'TEST JOB RING', 'Test job ring', '#TEST-RING', 'Auto-dismiss in 41s' (countdown decreasing), plus JOB VALUE / PAYMENT / TYPE tiles and Accept Job / View details / Decline buttons. Tapping [data-testid=ring-accept] dismisses the overlay (still_visible=False). Second trigger via page.evaluate POST /api/partner/test-ring (Authorization: Bearer …) returned 200 with body {ok:true, sse:true, partner:'Raj Kumar', …} and overlay re-appeared; tapping [data-testid=ring-decline] dismissed it. Third trigger + tap [data-testid=ring-view] dismissed overlay AND navigated to /jobs (URL confirmed) where 'Live dispatch connected' is still shown. Regression: Dashboard/Job Request/Active Job/Wallet all rendered with zero [data-testid=error-screen] elements. Logout → 'Maybe later' → Partner Demo again → SSE reconnected (2nd /api/realtime/stream request observed, status 200) and 'Live dispatch connected' appears again on Jobs. Only console warning present is the expected 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported' (harmless on web); no pageerror events. Real end-to-end booking flow (customer books → partner overlay) was skipped as marked optional in the request. Sound/vibration cannot be verified headless (per request).
action_items: No functional issues found — realtime SSE + JobRingOverlay is ship-ready.

Optional: The overlay's Decline button visible label is 'Decline' but the seeded test message body says 'Tap Accept or Reject to dismiss.' — trivial copy inconsistency; either rename button to 'Reject' or update backend test-ring message to say 'Accept or Decline'. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: RealtimeContext.tsx line 80: AppState handler always calls connect() with retryRef=1 when the app becomes active while esRef exists, effectively forcing a reconnect on every foreground event even when the socket is healthy. Consider skipping when esRef.current is non-null AND connected=true so we don't churn the SSE stream on every tab-focus.

RealtimeContext.tsx line 56: JWT is embedded in the URL as ?token=… which is fine for EventSource (no headers) but note it can end up in server access logs. If backend logging masks it already, ignore.

JobRingOverlay.tsx line 50: subscribe effect deps intentionally suppressed via eslint-disable — safe because subscribe/playRing/stopRing come from a stable useMemo, but consider using a ref for the latest job state to avoid re-subscribing on every job change (not currently happening since only [subscribe] is in the array).

JobRingOverlay.tsx line 63: interval + Animated.loop cleanup keyed on job?.id — if a second job_request arrives with the SAME id (rare), the countdown won't reset. Consider keying on `${job?.id}-${ringNonce}` where ringNonce increments on each job_request event.

JobRingOverlay.tsx line 39: Vibration.vibrate([0,500,300,500,300,500], true) will keep vibrating forever if the effect unmounts before dismiss() runs (route change, etc.). We do call Vibration.cancel() in dismiss(), but if the modal is closed by parent unmount (e.g., logout while ringing) it won't fire — consider a cleanup in the subscribe useEffect.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 feature groups: SSE connect + all 3 overlay button actions + regression + relogin reconnect)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Realtime layer verified end-to-end. Key facts: (1) SSE endpoint is GET /api/realtime/stream?token=JWT (EventSource, no headers) — token in query. (2) POST /api/partner/test-ring with Bearer token emits a `job_request` SSE frame with is_test=true; response body contains partner + sse:true. (3) JobRingOverlay renders inside app/(partner)/_layout.tsx above the <Tabs>, so it overlays every partner sub-route. (4) On accept/decline/view for a test ring the overlay just dismisses (no /accept or /reject API call — those are gated on !job.is_test). (5) ring-view navigates to /(partner)/jobs then dismisses. (6) Jobs page footer 'Live dispatch connected' only renders inside the empty-state <Surface>; when jobs list is non-empty the footer isn't shown (by design — matches web parity). (7) Logout clears the SSE (esRef.current closed) and relogin triggers a fresh EventSource — verified 2 stream connections during this test.
